entries.title: Agentic SDLC factory toolchain
entries.summary: The composition of protocols and SDKs behind an agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC) factory — ACP and AHP for agent wiring and hosting, Pierre, t3code, Effect (durable-execution surface source-backed), OpenCode, and the Pi SDK as the tooling layer, plus the CI-native gh-aw workflow layer and the followed engineering-blog feeds (Zed, Solo.io, Mastra) folded into one pipeline.

entries.title: Generative-UI ecosystem
entries.summary: Cross-source comparison of the competing approaches to streaming agent-driven UI — AG-UI (event wire protocol), A2UI (declarative JSON), OpenUI (declarative language + runtime), MCP Apps (iframe apps on MCP), and the frameworks that consume them.

entries.title: CopilotKit (generative-UI frontend stack)
entries.summary: CopilotKit is a 1st-party client/agent framework for building agent-powered apps with generative UI, consolidated into a monorepo and built on the AG-UI protocol; it renders static generative UI, A2UI declarative JSON, and MCP Apps UIs, and extends agents to chat platforms via its Channels SDK.

entries.title: Effect
entries.summary: Effect is a powerful TypeScript library for building complex synchronous and asynchronous programs with typed, composable effects; v4 is the current era. Its durable-execution surface (DurableQueue ported to v4, @effect/workflow in alpha) is confirmed source-backed from the official Effect v4 beta documentation.

entries.title: Mastra agentic-UI integration
entries.summary: Mastra is a TypeScript AI framework whose agentic-UI layer integrates common generative-UI frontends (AI SDK UI, assistant-ui, CopilotKit, AG-UI) through @mastra/ai-sdk and a UI dojo of runnable examples; Mastra 1.0 stable adds A2A support, AI Tracing, and (as of 2026-08-18) agent-loop + nested-streaming orchestration built on AI SDK v5.

entries.title: OpenCode
entries.summary: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent available as a terminal UI, desktop app, or IDE extension, with a type-safe JavaScript/TypeScript SDK (@opencode-ai/sdk) for building integrations and controlling the opencode server programmatically.

entries.title: OpenUI (Open Standard for Generative UI)
entries.summary: OpenUI is a generative-UI toolkit for building agents that respond with interactive interfaces rather than text, comprising the Agent Interface frontend SDK, the OpenUI Lang streaming declarative language and runtime, and the OpenUI Cloud managed backend.

entries.title: OpenWiki
entries.summary: OpenWiki is a self-maintaining-wiki CLI (MIT, npm) that an agent uses to read sources, synthesize a linked Markdown wiki, and keep it current — with code and personal modes, built-in connectors (local git, Notion, Slack, Gmail, X, Web Search, Hacker News, Custom MCP, langsmith), 12 README-listed model providers (13 incl. GitHub Copilot on v0.3.3+), OKF v0.2 output grounded in versioned source Claims with validated Mermaid diagrams, an interactive visualizer, and CI self-update workflows. Releases-page trail: v0.3.3 latest (source-backed 2026-08-22); main's package.json declares v0.4.3 (source-backed 2026-08-29).

entries.title: Pi SDK
entries.summary: The Pi SDK provides programmatic access to the Pi coding agent's capabilities for embedding Pi in other applications, building custom interfaces, and integrating with automated workflows; documented at pi.dev/docs/latest/sdk, with an official release trail through v0.84.2 on pi.dev/news.

entries.title: Pierre (Pierre Computer Company)
entries.summary: Pierre is the open-source TypeScript toolkit from the Pierre Computer Company for diffs, trees, and memes, including the @pierre/diffs library that renders and edits file diffs; maintained at github.com/pierrecomputer/pierre.

entries.title: t3code
entries.summary: T3 Code is an "agent harness control surface" for managing the coding agents on your machine (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode) from a mobile, web, or Electron desktop app; launched with npx t3@latest.

entries.title: Open Questions
entries.summary: Active, answered, and stale questions about the AI knowledge wiki's coverage and memory graph, including gaps in evidence about projects tracked in this corpus (e.g. Effect's deep Workflow/Activity API semantics, CopilotKit package versions, A2UI v1.0 GA status, OpenWiki v0.4.x release confirmation). OpenWiki's OKF version and current-release questions are now answered (releases-page v0.3.3; OKF v0.2 output; main HEAD at v0.4.3, watchlist).

entries.title: A2UI (Agent to UI) Protocol
entries.summary: A2UI is a declarative, Apache-2.0 UI protocol for agent-driven interfaces, in which agents generate a JSON payload describing UI components that render natively across web, mobile, and desktop without executing arbitrary code.

entries.title: AG-UI (Agent-User Interaction Protocol)
entries.summary: AG-UI is an open, lightweight, event-based wire protocol for streaming AI agent output to user-facing applications, standardizing how agents describe and stream UI over SSE, WebSockets, HTTP, and custom transports.

entries.title: Agent Client Protocol (ACP)
entries.summary: The Agent Client Protocol (ACP) is a standardized communication protocol between code editors and AI-powered coding agents, officially implemented in TypeScript by the @agentclientprotocol/sdk package; the spec repo also ships Rust/schema artifacts and GitHub Copilot CLI is an official ACP server.

entries.title: Agent Host Protocol (AHP)
entries.summary: The Agent Host Protocol (AHP) is Microsoft's synchronized, multi-client state protocol for AI agent sessions, framed on JSON-RPC 2.0 with channel-based routing, immutable state, pure reducers, and write-ahead reconciliation.

entries.title: MCP Apps (Model Context Protocol Apps extension)
entries.summary: MCP Apps is the first official extension to the Model Context Protocol, co-developed by Anthropic and OpenAI, letting MCP servers deliver interactive UIs (charts, forms, dashboards) rendered securely in sandboxed iframes inside any compliant host — with a 5-phase UI lifecycle, ui:// tool-linked resources, JSON-RPC-over-postMessage communication, tool visibility, host theming/context, display modes, and a View-side App runtime API (@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps).

entries.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
entries.summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is the open standard for how AI agents integrate with external tools, data sources, and other agents — JSON-RPC 2.0-based tools, resources, and prompts with capability negotiation, sampling, elicitation, authorization, and a 2026-07-28 revision that made the core stateless, added Multi Round-Trip Requests, header-based routing, cacheable list results, full JSON Schema 2020-12 for tool schemas, and a formal extensions framework and lifecycle policy. The 2026-08-22 "New MCP Roadmap" supersedes the March roadmap with five priority areas.

entries.title: Open Knowledge Format (OKF)
entries.summary: OKF is a minimal, vendor-neutral format for representing knowledge as markdown files with YAML frontmatter in a self-describing bundle — standardizing the small set of structural conventions (required type, provenance, trust, lifecycle, attestation) that make an agent-maintained knowledge corpus trustable. The canonical spec now lives in the standalone GoogleCloudPlatform/open-knowledge-format repository (the knowledge-catalog okf/ copy is a frozen snapshot); a growing ecosystem (okc, erd2okf, okf-gem, okf-mcp, openknowledge, okf-ingest, okf-skill, okf-lint, KSoR/KSP-001) backs the v0.2 spec.

entries.title: AI Knowledge Wiki Quickstart
entries.summary: Navigation and current status for the AI knowledge corpus — the Model Context Protocol (MCP) core and its 2026-07-28 stateless revision (revision, SDK posture, registry, extensions, the 2026-08-22 "New MCP Roadmap", and MCP Apps interface surface refreshed 2026-08-29 with the View-side App runtime API), the Agent Host Protocol (AHP), Agent Client Protocol (ACP), the generative-UI / agent-UI protocol ecosystem (with the AG-UI Kotlin SDK, Cedar-OS, full A2UI v0.9.1 spec, AG-UI package versions, and the 2026-08-29 Generative UI re-pull deltas), the agentic SDLC factory toolchain (Pierre, t3code, Effect, OpenCode, Pi SDK, gh-aw CI workflows, and the followed blog feeds), and the agent-maintained knowledge-base layer (the Open Knowledge Format v0.2 spec — canonical home now the standalone open-knowledge-format repo, knowledge-catalog/okf/ frozen — and its growing producer/consumer ecosystem — okc, erd2okf, okf-gem/okf-mcp, AKB, openknowledge, okf-ingest, okf-lint, KSoR/KSP-001 — plus the OpenWiki CLI, 12+ model providers, OKF v0.2 output, releases-page v0.3.3 latest with main at v0.4.3, that maintains this wiki; refreshed 2026-08-29 with the Agent-wiki re-pull, the gh-aw two-layer versioning model, Mastra Studio metrics/logs, the AHP#282 ACP/AHP composition framing, and the Agent integration protocols re-pull).

entries.title: Model Context Protocol releases
entries.summary: Versioned revision history of the Model Context Protocol specification and Tier 1 SDK posture — revisions 2025-03-26, 2025-06-18, 2025-11-25 (RC 2025-11-15), and the current stateless 2026-07-28 revision, plus the Java SDK v2.0.0 GA (tracking 2025-11-25), the TypeScript SDK v2.0.0 monorepo split, beta SDK versions for Go and C#, and companion-repo release trails (servers, swift-sdk, mcpb, registry).

entries.title: Recurring themes and trends
entries.summary: Compact index of recurring signals across the AI knowledge corpus — standardization and convergence of generative-UI / agent-UI protocols in 2026, MCP core standardization toward production infrastructure (stateless 2026-07-28 core, extensions framework, DCR→CIMD), the emerging agentic SDLC factory toolchain (including its CI-native gh-aw layer), and the emergence of agent-maintained knowledge-base formats and tooling (OKF v0.2 in its canonical open-knowledge-format repo, OpenWiki main at v0.4.3 with a v0.3.3 releases-page trail).
